subject: Orbica discovery & eval: recommended models, benchmark links, snapshot request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@orbica.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Orbica discovery recap + recommended models & next steps

Hi Elena / Michael —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment:

1) Primary goal:
- Reduce false-positive classification in refund detection rules (target: <=2% FP on production sample) while keeping recall >=94%.

2) Recommended evaluation plan (we'll deliver the artifacts below):
- Two candidate families: rw-instruct-13b-v2 (lower latency, quant-friendly) and redwood-70b-qr (higher quality for edge cases).
- Benchmark suite: customer-provided production sample (50k rows) + our standard fraud-eval set.
- Prompt set (attached): 120 representative cases, with golden labels and edge-case prompts.

3) Immediate asks from Orbica:
- Please share a scoped sample of production traffic (anonymized) and any manual rules or golden labels.
- Can we have a short eval window next week (Mon-Wed) for model comparisons?

4) Risk note (we flagged during the call):
- You mentioned a recent model update on your side caused a subtle shift in classification. If we see similar sensitivity in our variants, we recommend pinning a known-good model snapshot while we run the evaluation to avoid a mid-testing drift.

I've attached: orbica-eval-benchmarks.csv (template), prompt-set-v1.txt.

Next steps: Elena to confirm sample delivery ETA. Redwood to run a quick smoke-run on rw-instruct-13b-v2 and redwood-70b-qr when data arrives, then share benchmark CSV and a short summary.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

Attachments: orbica-eval-benchmarks.csv, prompt-set-v1.txt
From: Elena Soto <elena@orbica.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Tan <michael.tan@orbica.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T17:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orbica discovery recap + recommended models & next steps

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few clarifications:

- We can deliver a 15k anonymized sample by Friday (May 8). It will include the manual rule outputs and a small golden set (~2k) labeled by ops.
- Timeline: we want to run the smoke eval next Wednesday (May 13) so we can report to ops on May 15. Can Redwood confirm availability?
- On pinning: yes, Michael will share the version id of the current production model. If your evaluation shows regressions vs that snapshot, we want the option to lock to the previous snapshot for the trial.

Also: can you include a short note on how Redwood handles model diffs (token-level divergence examples, prompt sensitivity) — we want concrete artifacts for our SRE and compliance review.

Best,
Elena
Head of Risk Ops | Orbica
elena@orbica.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-05T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: orbica sample prep + snapshot strategy

Marissa / Soojin —

Read the call notes and Elena's timeline. Two operational items before the smoke run:

1) Snapshot/pin approach:
- Recommend we _create a read-only snapshot_ of the current recommended production candidate (rw-instruct-13b-v2@2026-04-20) and label it ORBICATEST-snapshot-20260505.
- If evaluation shows meaningful regression on orbital-specific prompts (>3% abs FP increase), propose auto-rollback policy for the trial: pin traffic to the snapshot for the trial cohort and continue offline experiments on headroom.

2) Diff artifacts to prepare (Elena asked for concrete examples):
- Top-50 prompt diffs: token-by-token side-by-side with logprob deltas (CSV).
- Confusion matrix per-class and a short list of 10 representative prompts where candidate disagrees with golden label.
- Per-prompt input-output trace (JSONL) for audit (we'll strip PII).

3) Resourcing & scheduling:
- I'll reserve dedicated infra for Wed May 13 08:00-16:00 PT. Need the sample in our secure share by EOD May 8.

I'll start producing a lightweight runbook and a support ticket to prioritize this.

-Rishi
Sr. Applied ML Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-05T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: orbica sample prep + snapshot strategy

Agree with Rishi. A few operational clarifications:

- Please attach the exact command/endpoint we'll use so Orbica can reproduce locally (we should send a stub doc in the customer packet).
- For the audit traces: replace user-identifiers with hashed ids and include a small mapping scheme note in the artifact header.
- I'll open a priority support ticket (SUP-9876) and cc Elena once we have the snapshot ID. We should also include a short rollback SLA for the trial window: 1 hour to pin traffic to snapshot once regression is confirmed.

I'll prepare the runbook and a minimal script to extract the top-50 diffs. Rishi — can you own the CSV format and the sample header fields?

Thanks,
Soojin
Applied ML Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@orbica.com>, Michael Tan <michael.tan@orbica.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-06T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orbica discovery recap + recommended models & next steps

Elena / Michael — quick status:

- Sample: confirmed ETA from Orbica = 2026-05-08 EOD.
- Snapshot: we've created ORBICATEST-snapshot-20260505 (rw-instruct-13b-v2@2026-04-20) and uploaded metadata to the shared Drive folder.
- Artifacts we'll deliver after Wed run (May 13): orbica-eval-benchmarks.csv (full metrics), top-50-prompt-diffs.csv, per-prompt traces (PII stripped), short write-up with recommended candidate and operational recommendation.
- Rollback/pin: Redwood support ticket SUP-9876 opened; proposed trial rollback SLA = 1 hour (will pin to snapshot for trial cohort).

Attached: proposal-draft-ORB-2026.pdf (commercial draft) — please review pricing & trial terms, we can adjust for enterprise procurement.

Proposed immediate next actions for you:
1) Deliver anonymized sample by EOD May 8 to the Drive link.
2) Confirm the production model id you want us to compare against (if different from the one we snapshot).
3) Approve the trial rollback SLA so we can include it in the trial agreement.

Happy to jump on a 15-minute sync if helpful before the run.

Thanks,
Marissa
(end of thread)
